points.note: Cutting a note without a word loses what the user typed. Refuse a note over 2000 characters and say so on the page.
points.found: The issue says an invoice has a free-text notes field and gives no limit. The code cuts notes to 2000 characters before they are stored, and it shows no message when it cuts.

points.note: No test keeps the CSV files of two workspaces apart. Add one: a user of another workspace must never get this file.
points.found: This line makes the workspace part of the key under which a built CSV file is kept. When the workspace was taken out of the key, a user could download a file that holds the invoices of another workspace, and every test still passed.

touched.title: Notes are cleaned and cut to 2000 characters before they are stored
